body:
🩸 Neoxira Lifesteal SMP

Welcome to Neoxira Lifesteal SMP, a simple yet exciting Minecraft Lifesteal experience where every heart matters. Kill players to steal their hearts, grow stronger, and dominate the server. But be careful—every death costs you a heart, bringing you closer to elimination.

⚔️ Features

Classic Lifesteal mechanics
Competitive PvP and survival gameplay
Team up with friends or fight solo
Active community and events
Smooth performance with minimal lag
Vanilla-friendly experience

🏹 Build your base, form alliances, start wars, and create your own story in a world where survival is everything. Every battle has consequences, and every heart can change your fate.

Can you become the strongest player in Neoxira? Join and find out! 🩸🔥

Inspired by the popular Lifesteal SMP concept where players gain hearts from kills and lose hearts on death.
